game.title: Dead Rising 2
game.blurb: Open-world zombie action game from Capcom U.S.A, Capcom Vancouver and Blue Castle Games, published by Capcom, released 2010-08-31. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Facts and Overtime
chapters.summary: The main story, case by case (StrategyWiki lists Case 1 to Case 7 and Overtime), finishing The Facts and then Overtime Mode. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Survivors, Psychopaths and Katey
chapters.summary: Saving and escorting survivors, defeating psychopaths, gifts for Katey and taming Snowflake.

chapters.title: Combo Weapons and Combo Cards
chapters.summary: Creating combo weapons and collecting the combo cards hidden around Fortune City or earned from survivors and psychopaths.

chapters.title: Life in Fortune City
chapters.summary: Clothes, mixed drinks, food, every store, spending money, the Zombrex posters, zombie masks, a custom bike and the notebook.

chapters.title: Zombie Slaying and Levels
chapters.summary: Zombie kill counts, kills barehanded, on a motorcycle and with every weapon type, gas zombies, the Smash move and reaching levels 25 and 50.

chapters.title: Co-op and Terror Is Reality
chapters.summary: Solving case files in co-op, reviving a partner, and winning TIR events and episodes. Online or with a second player.

collectibles.name: Zombie Slaughter
collectibles.where: Killed 500 zombies. Not a bad start.

collectibles.name: Zombie Destruction
collectibles.where: Killed 5,000 zombies. Is that all you've got?

collectibles.name: Z-Genocider 2: Genocide Harder
collectibles.where: Killed 53,596 zombies. You left them all for dead!

collectibles.name: Zombie Genocide Master
collectibles.where: Killed 72,000 zombies. King of carnage!

collectibles.name: Vigilante Justice
collectibles.where: Defeated 5 psychopaths. There's a new sheriff in town!

collectibles.name: Judge, Jury and Executioner
collectibles.where: Defeated 10 psychopaths. The world is a safer place.

collectibles.name: Zombie Fu
collectibles.where: Killed 1,000 zombies barehanded. Those were some killer moves!

collectibles.name: Wrong Kind of "Chopper"
collectibles.where: Killed 1,000 zombies while riding a motorcycle. Chainsaws on the side make it easier.

collectibles.name: He Hasn't Covered Wars...
collectibles.where: Used every type of firearm on a zombie. Bang!

collectibles.name: Head Trauma
collectibles.where: Used every type of melee weapon on a zombie. Anything is deadly in the right hands.

collectibles.name: Death From Afar
collectibles.where: Used every type of ranged weapon on a zombie. They can't bite you if they're already dead.

collectibles.name: Explosive Temper
collectibles.where: Used every type of explosive on a zombie. Kaboom!

collectibles.name: Slaughter - S = Laughter!
collectibles.where: Used every type of novelty weapon on a zombie. Lighten up a bit!

collectibles.name: Come on! Follow Me!
collectibles.where: Escorted 8 survivors at once. It's a party, everyone is invited!

collectibles.name: Saving the Day
collectibles.where: Saved 10 survivors. But more are still out there...

collectibles.name: Hero of Fortune City
collectibles.where: Saved 50 survivors. What a great guy!

collectibles.name: Needs More Chainsaw
collectibles.where: Created a combo weapon. Introduce it to the nearest zombie!

collectibles.name: Duct Tape FTW
collectibles.where: Created all combo weapons. Now put them to use!

collectibles.name: Apprentice Rising
collectibles.where: Reached level 25. Halfway there!

collectibles.name: Professional Rising
collectibles.where: Reached level 50. You're a machine!

collectibles.name: Fashion Aficionado
collectibles.where: Changed into 10 different pieces of clothing. Looking dapper, chap!

collectibles.name: Chuck Greene: Cross-Dresser?
collectibles.where: Changed into all the clothes in the game. Zombie invasion is no excuse for poor style.

collectibles.name: Clean Record
collectibles.where: Completed The Facts. The End... or is it?

collectibles.name: Bartender
collectibles.where: Mixed a drink. Tasty stuff!

collectibles.name: Look at All That Juice!
collectibles.where: Created and consumed all mixed drinks in the game. Just like Mom used to make.

collectibles.name: Finally Full
collectibles.where: Ate all types of food in the game. That can't be healthy.

collectibles.name: Having a Gas
collectibles.where: Killed 1,000 gas zombies. As if zombies weren't bad enough...

collectibles.name: Father of the Month
collectibles.where: Gave Katey a gift. It's good to spoil her sometimes.

collectibles.name: Father of the Year
collectibles.where: Gave Katey every possible gift. Bribery is the fastest way to earn a child's love!

collectibles.name: Justice Served
collectibles.where: Completed Overtime Mode. TK got what he deserved.

collectibles.name: Better With a Friend
collectibles.where: Solved all case files in Co-op. You're a great friend!

collectibles.name: Don't You Die on Me!
collectibles.where: Revived another player in Co-op. He owes you one.

collectibles.name: Big Spender
collectibles.where: Spent $6,000,000 total in Fortune City. Where did you get all that money?

collectibles.name: Window Shopper
collectibles.where: Entered all the stores in the game. Did you buy anything?

collectibles.name: Masquerade
collectibles.where: Had 10 zombies with masks on at once. You showed them who's boss!

collectibles.name: Improper Behavior
collectibles.where: Spray-painted all Zombrex posters. They didn't do much good in the first place.

collectibles.name: TK's Favorite
collectibles.where: Played and won in all 9 TIR events. A true American hero!

collectibles.name: Rising Star
collectibles.where: Came in first place in a single TIR event. Victory tastes sweet!

collectibles.name: Win Big!
collectibles.where: Finished in first place in a TIR episode. Don and Paul love watching you go!

collectibles.name: Custom Finish
collectibles.where: Gave your bike a custom paint job. Sweet ride!

collectibles.name: Curiously Inventive
collectibles.where: Collected all combo cards hidden in Fortune City. Inspiration is all around you.

collectibles.name: Life Saver
collectibles.where: Collected all combo cards from survivors. The gift of zombie killing!

collectibles.name: Tough Guy
collectibles.where: Collected all combo cards from psychopaths. Pried from their cold, dead fingers.

collectibles.name: Half Deck
collectibles.where: Collected 25 combo cards. So many combinations, so little time.

collectibles.name: Full Deck
collectibles.where: Collected all combo cards. All 49. Seems odd, doesn't it?

collectibles.name: Data Miner
collectibles.where: Filled all entries in the notebook and made some friends along the way.

collectibles.name: Smashy
collectibles.where: Smashed 100 zombies using the Smash skill move. Brains everywhere!

collectibles.name: Stick 'em up
collectibles.where: Covered a zombie in objects. That sure was funny!

collectibles.name: The Skill to Survive
collectibles.where: Tamed Snowflake. Keep some steak handy, just in case.

collectibles.name: Tape It or DIE!
collectibles.where: Hidden on Steam: the unlock condition is secret. Most likely tied to story progress, so it is spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 1322). Steam app 45740 ("Dead Rising® 2") from the store list; its schema has no game name. 1 of 50 Steam achievements is hidden ("Tape It or DIE!", no description); it sits in the story chapter as a placeholder, though deadrising.fandom.com has pages named "Tape It or Die 1" and "Tape It or Die 2", so it may belong elsewhere. RAWG's detail says 400 achievements, far more than Steam's 50. RAWG lists two additions, "Dead Rising 2: CASE ZERO" (2010-08-12) and "DEAD RISING 2: CASE WEST" (2010-12-26); "Dead Rising 2: Off the Record" (app 45770) is a separate RAWG entry and Steam app, and none of these has a chapter here. StrategyWiki has the guide under "Dead Rising 2" at completion stage 0: only Achievements and trophies (about 7,700 characters), Timeline (about 6,100), Table of Contents (about 2,600), Controls (about 2,000) and Achievements (Case Zero) (about 2,000) are written; Gameplay, Tips, Walkthrough, Intro, Case 1 to Case 7, Overtime, the area pages, Survivors and Combo cards are linked but not written, so it was not used. The case list in the story summary comes from those page names. "Terror Is Reality" is a deadrising.fandom.com page name; the achievements say "TIR". deadrising.fandom.com answers the API under "Dead Rising 2" with about 126 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
